title: Hovering the Sales Representative row shows the box, arrow and +
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-03-n1-hover.png" (board 1.3) and "card-06-n1-picked-hover.png" (board 1.6) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative row and compare with the picture of board 1.6.
  2. Measure the box and the + button.
  3. Hover over the + itself.
  4. Move the pointer away, then move into the field with the keyboard (Tab).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one box around the label and the name together, the same box and height Lead Technician and Service Advisor show on hover, same left edge; the dropdown arrow at the right end, vertically centred on the label and the name; the grey + to the right, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the box ends 16 px before a 32 px column holding the +; the + is a 32 px square with 8 px corners and a 20 px plus icon, grey on no fill.
  • Step 3: the + shows a light fill.
  • Step 4: while the field has keyboard focus the box, the arrow and the + stay shown.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R4, S1-R5, S1-R11, S2-R1, S2-R2, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design pictures measure about 22 px between the box and the + on the work order card (16 px in the customer window). This case follows the PRD's 16 px; the difference is on the product owner's question sheet.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “Hovering anywhere on the Sales Representative rows shows, on every Sales Representative field at once, the same box Lead Technician and Service Advisor show on hover, around the label and the name together, at the same height as those two fields and the same left edge. The dropdown arrow (S1-R11) and the buttons beside the fields (S2-R1, S2-R8) show at the same time. All of them stay shown while a Sales Representative dropdown or the + menu is open, or while a field has keyboard focus.”
  • S1-R5: “The box ends 16px before the 32px column that holds the + and remove x buttons.”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”
  • S2-R1: “A + button sits to the right of the Sales Representative field: the design system's Tertiary button in its small icon-only size, 32px square with 8px corners, showing the Lucide plus icon at 20px.”
  • S2-R2: “At rest the icon is grey on no fill. Hovering the button shows a light fill. The light fill stays while its menu is open.”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.3 Hover: the box and the +; 1.6 Hover: box, arrow and + (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-03-n1-hover.png, card-06-n1-picked-hover.png.

  • Design — board 1.3 title: “1.3 Hover: the box and the +”
  • Design — board 1.3 note: “Hovering the rep row shows the field box with its dropdown arrow, and the grey + beside it.”
  • Design — board 1.6 title: “1.6 Hover: box, arrow and +”
  • Design — board 1.6 note: “With a person in the field, hovering shows the same box and arrow, and the + beside the row. To clear it, pick "Unassigned" from the list (decision 69).”
